Please continue the width allocation discussion in #2890. For this layout, set `Table(expand=True)` and give `Biography` `ratio=1`, keeping `no_wrap=True` and `overflow="ellipsis"`; that lets the column use the remaining terminal width. The [table docs](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/tables.rst) describe table expansion and column ratios and options.
